_comment: The game loop. Industry is the one resource: each planet or moon you hold adds its industry value (from the system file) per day. Ships cost their class cost in Industry, paid when the shipyard starts them, and take cost / buildIndustryPerDay days. Research: teams work through their own queues (see teams); each idea is paid when its team starts it. Each idea has a field (drives, weapons or sensors: the team skill it uses), ideas it needs first, a filter group (unlocks) and a card picture. A neutral or enemy body is claimed after a side holds orbit there for claimDays with no enemy fleet in orbit; a body the other side holds takes claimHeldDays. A shipyard is destroyed when its armour runs out under bombardment by an enemy fleet in orbit with no defenders nearby. A held body with people can only be taken by its surrender or by troops (see planets). Win: the enemy shipyard is destroyed, or a side holds planets.tipShare of control for planets.winAfterDays (or reaches planets.winShare). holdToWinDays is no longer used.

_teamsComment: Research teams. A side starts with one team of startScientists and has slots team slots. Speed = skill in the idea's field x (scientists / baseScientists)^0.75. Each finished idea adds skillPerIdea to the team's skill in that field, up to maxSkill. Fields a team doesn't keep (1-2 chosen, or its best one) fade by fadePer30Days back towards 1. Founding a team costs foundCost and takes foundDays; it starts with foundScientists and foundSkill in its chosen field. Training adds trainScientists for trainCost after trainDays. Splitting moves half the scientists into an empty slot with 1 + splitShare x each skill above 1. Holding orbit at a body for surveyHours the first time surveys it: surveyCut off one random idea not yet researched. tierPace stretches each idea's listed days by its tier (tier 1 first): the listed days are the work at skill 1 before that stretch.
_planetsComment: Planets and people (see Planets). Population is in thousands (k). cap is the most people a body of that type can hold (moons get moonCapShare of it; homes at least homeCap); farm is food per farm per day as a share of a terran farm; plots is how many buildings fit. Each 1k people eat foodPerKPerDay; a farm feeds farmFoodPerDay. Growth is logistic at growthPerDay while fed. A settled body makes its industry when staffed (baseStaffK, plus each building's staffK); an empty body you hold makes unsettledShare of it. Happiness moves happinessPerDay towards its target; a blockaded planet below surrenderBelow (surrenderBelowTipped once the blockader leads with tipShare of control) gives itself up, unless it holds a grudge (bombing its people). Win: tipShare of control for winAfterDays, or winShare at once.

_coloniesComment: Colonies (see Colonies): each body's board size and terrain come from its planet type (w, h, ocean, ice, mountain shares, minerals and how many deposits). Buildings are pieces on the board. Goods are kept per planet; storage holds baseStoreDays of use plus storehouses. Without spare parts a building loses wearPerDay of condition (output falls to half at 0) and mends mendPerDay with them. Ships refuelling at a planet use fuelPerSupply fuel per supply point, or refill at noFuelRefill speed with none. Research that upgrades a building refits it over refitDays at refitOutput, then it makes levelBoost more per upgrade. Auto transport sends freighters when a planet holds under askBelow of its siege target. Presets are the priority orders.
_stationsComment: Stations are built in orbit of a body you hold, paid at once, working after days; they are lost with the body. A relay passes signals (orders and reports) round planets that block the straight line from the flagship; each relay hop adds relayDelayHours unless Tight-beam comms is researched. A held planet sees like a ship (planetBareSensorMm in ship-classes.json) until it has a sensor station; the shipyard planet always sees full range.
